basis: Immune-mediated arterial vasculitis. Neuropathy and damaging skin-lesion frequencies in systemic PAN cannot reliably be generalized to this cutaneous/single-organ/systemic umbrella.

decisions.neurologic: none: neuropathy affects ~50-70% in systemic PAN; a >=30% frequency across the full primary-PAN umbrella is not established.
decisions.dermatologic: none: systemic-PAN skin findings (~40-60%) include nondamaging signs; common direct skin damage across the full umbrella is not established.

basis: Pelvic organ prolapse includes structural descent of the bladder/urethra and rectum, as well as reproductive organs; urinary and intestinal labels reflect prolapse itself, not symptoms alone.

decisions.renal: primary: bladder/urethral prolapse is a core anatomical form of pelvic organ prolapse, rather than merely associated urinary symptoms.
decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: rectal descent into the vaginal wall is a core anatomical form; the prolapsed bowel itself establishes the axis.

basis: CNS hypomyelination; fixed contractures and kyphoscoliosis each affect 6/7. Visual impairment in 7/7 may be central; nystagmus and strabismus do not establish direct ocular injury.

decisions.ocular: none: visual impairment in 7/7 can reflect CNS disease; no retinal, optic-nerve or other direct ocular damage is established.

basis: Defining Noonan cardiac defects; prolonged PT 2/2, keratosis pilaris 3/5 and developmental delay 2/5 support involvement. Short/webbed neck and short stature alone do not establish skeletal damage.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent follicular keratosis occurs in 3/5 (60%), supporting direct skin involvement.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: short/webbed neck and short stature are dysmorphic/growth features without established damaging skeletal disease.

basis: Aspergillus infection or hypersensitivity; pulmonary infiltrates and impaired lung function occur in 30-79%. Extrapulmonary injury is occasional; neutropenia usually predisposes to infection.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: direct pulmonary disease occurs in 30-79%; the umbrella also includes extrapulmonary infection and is not anatomically restricted to lungs.

basis: Severe T-cell-mediated ulceronecrotic PLEVA destroys skin. The immune axis reflects the inflammatory disease mechanism, not secondary infection; common direct extracutaneous damage is unestablished.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: FUMHD is a severe immune-mediated, cytotoxic T-cell inflammatory skin disorder; secondary ulcer infection is not the reason for this axis.

basis: Intellectual disability and intestinal/cardiac anomalies define the syndrome. Coloboma and microphthalmia occur in 80-99%; ocular involvement follows the three definition-based primaries.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: cardiac anomalies are explicitly defining; individual lesion frequencies of 5-29% do not measure their combined frequency.
decisions.ocular: involved: structural coloboma and microphthalmia occur in 80-99%; the three primary slots prioritize organs explicitly named in the definition.

basis: Urate metabolic disease causes crystal-triggered autoinflammatory arthritis through innate immune activation. Renal stones and chronic kidney disease are separate diagnoses.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: gout is crystal-induced autoinflammatory arthritis mediated by innate immune activation; the mechanism axis includes immune-mediated disease.

basis: Defined as dominant TTN-related myopathy. Cardiomyopathy and respiratory failure characterize particular subtypes; neither is established as common across the full myopathy umbrella.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: cardiomyopathy subtypes are included, but their presence among children does not establish cardiac disease in most patients across the umbrella.

basis: Inherited fibrosing tubulointerstitial nephritis. Transaminases elevated in 5/9 (~56%) do not establish sustained direct liver damage; DNA repair disease alone is not metabolic.

decisions.hepatic: none: transaminase elevation in 5/9 (~56%) is insufficient alone to establish direct, sustained hepatic damage; functional liver disease is not documented.
